decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already establishes internal-page header content containing RR-01, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Changing the footer report identifier to RR-01 does not alter the final-page warning's presence, visual treatment, or confidentiality message.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY requiring RR-01 throughout the RR01 report, which fully represents the identifier-consistency impact.
The RR-01 footer value does not change the requirement that report IDs and other customer fields remain editable.
The footer identifier change does not alter the dashboard's score presentation, heading, result fields, or prominence.
The footer identifier change does not affect the content or presentation of the front-page result explanation.
Using RR-01 in the footer is a specific identifier correction and does not modify the report's broader premium visual-style requirement.
The footer identifier correction does not change the required fonts, icons, design assets, or their intended handoff use.
The RR-01 footer identifier does not alter the required report variants, source editability, export support, or format selection.
Correcting the RR01 report identifier to RR-01 does not change how report variants map to customer scores, risk bands, or exposure levels.
